name: Lofoten Islands
summary: The Lofoten Islands rise from the sea in a wall of jagged peaks, with red fishermen's cabins (rorbuer) on stilts, white beaches and drying racks of cod. Summer brings the midnight sun and hiking; winter brings northern lights over the fjords.
seasonNote: June to August has the midnight sun and the best hiking. February to March brings the skrei cod season and good northern lights. Weather changes fast at any time of year.
arrival: Fly from Bodø to Leknes or Svolvær, or take the car ferry from Bodø to Moskenes (about 3 to 4 hours). Hurtigruten ships stop at Svolvær and Stamsund.
gettingAround: Rent a car; a single road (the E10) runs the length of the islands.
cashTip: Norway is almost cashless; cards and phone payments work everywhere, even for tiny amounts.
foodTip: Stockfish, fresh cod (skrei) in winter, fish cakes and fish soup.
baseArea: A rorbu cabin in Reine, Hamnøy or Henningsvær

connections.note: Via Bodø; or a scenic drive.
